voice.firstParagraph: I'm an Adobe Experience Manager Champion (class of 2026-2027), AEM Rockstar winner at Adobe Summit 2024, and an Adobe Certified Master. As an Associate Director in Accenture's Adobe Business Group in Columbus, Ohio, I build AI agent systems on AEM and Edge Delivery Services, then write up what I learn.
